requirements.text: Scenario 1 — Shared mode access to color, depth and infrared frame sources
requirements.reason: Full structural coverage; description, Next Source Group button (live), Color/Depth/Infrared labels and 'No source groups found.' status all match UWP golden.

requirements.text: Scenario 2 — Find and display all media frame sources
requirements.reason: All five controls present with AutomationIds; 2/5 coverage is a false negative (UWP source combos have empty x:Name). Start/Stop correctly disabled (no camera); select→Start→preview flow unverifiable on no-camera hardware for either app.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: None — environment-limited + measurement artifact, not a skill defect.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Camera state signalled only via the status line ('No source groups found.').
visual_discrepancies.winui: Fallback message 'This sample requires a camera device...' rendered twice (static orange TextBlock + dynamic FallbackMessage with same text).

summary: Faithful, functional replica. The only migration-attributable cosmetic defect is the duplicated camera-unavailable fallback message, which traces to the skill's own Defensive-UI wording. Remaining items are platform defaults (theme) or environment-limited (no camera).
